text:
marta: Quick ask — starting a safelist sync test for the Q2 onboarding playbook. Goal: prevent auto-touch for a pilot set of ~50 accounts flagged with crm:playbook_safelist. Planning to run staging sync at 14:00 PST, production if green at 22:00 UTC. Any objections?

sam: Sounds reasonable. Which CRM property are we reading from? crm:playbook_safelist or crm:whitelist_reason?

jen: We used crm:playbook_safelist in last manual run. Query we ran:
```sql
SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE crm.playbook_safelist = TRUE AND status != 'archived' LIMIT 100;
```
That returned 52 rows in staging.

sam: ok. One ask — if healthscore < 0.25 should we route to manual_review instead of skipping entirely? Otherwise we might hide churn signals.

marta: Good point. Plan is: safelist -> skip auto-touch unless healthscore < 0.25 then route to 'onboard-manual' playbook. I'll add that rule to the playbook config in staging.

alex: Heads up — playbook-exec service needs to respect the crm:playbook_safelist flag. I can patch it but need a small PR and a canary. I'll open it now.

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbook-exec/pull/432 — adds safelist check + healthscore override :eyes:

playbook-bot: TEST_RUN: simulated playbook 'onboarding_v2' against pilot segment (52 accounts). Results: 3 accounts skipped due to safelist, 2 rerouted to manual_review because healthscore < 0.25. No errors.

jen: Logs look clean. Can we schedule the production sync for 2025-03-25 22:00 UTC (off-peak) and run a 1h rollback window?

marta: Scheduled for 2025-03-25 22:00 UTC, rollback window 23:00 UTC. I'll update the internal runbook and ping support on rotation.

sam: :thumbsup: Also request — add a delta metric for 'healthscore_post_safelist' to monitoring so we can watch for regressions (Grafana alert if >5% accounts rerouted).

marta: Good call. I'll add the metric and open a dashboard PR.

jen: If the PR and staging run look good tomorrow, we're thumbs up for prod.

marta: Thanks everyone — will follow up after the staging sync. :v:
